boundaries: No full IEC 60287 / Neher-McGrath / FEM thermal calculation added.
No short-circuit, protection-coordination, grounding-grid or zero-sequence network calculation claimed.
Future reserve uses minimum applicable subsystem reserve; percentages are never summed.
defect_fixes: Thermal handoff now derives the active circuit list from the primary circuit register instead of requiring duplicate circuit IDs in the optional thermal-study table.
Removed a formula-engine parser defect caused by nested IFERROR in the new thermal handoff status formula.
Corrected the system-voltage status cell from an invalid =PASS formula to a literal PASS state.

schematic_boundary: Cell-grid plan/section schematic is automatically driven from calculated coordinates and selected-wall H/V data; it is explicitly not a CAD-certified construction drawing.
defect_fix: Vault schedule entry count changed from wildcard text counting to positive entry-quantity counting for reliable calculation-engine behavior.

48_STUDY_HANDOFF_RESERVE!E64 — blank-state future reserve status now returns N/A.
51_AUTO_PLAN_SECTION plan/section grid formulas — blank rows excluded and half-open bins prevent duplicate points on gridlines.
